args.body:
• Halvorsen Supply newsletter: covers freight pricing this quarter, with charts available via a mirror link if they don't load.
• Main article (blog.halvorsen.example/2026/freight): Spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held steady; fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Companion piece (insights.halvorsen.example/freight/companion): Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Halvorsen Supply Freight Newsletter Summary
